chk_not_same_stock.name: chk_not_same_stock
chk_not_same_stock.value:
NOT ("balance_movement_config"."from_stock_role" = "balance_movement_config"."to_stock_role" AND "balance_movement_config"."from_stock_role" <> 'SPECIFIC')
        AND ("balance_movement_config"."from_stock_id" IS NULL OR "balance_movement_config"."to_stock_id" IS NULL OR "balance_movement_config"."from_stock_id" <> "balance_movement_config"."to_stock_id")

chk_rule_fixed.name: chk_rule_fixed
chk_rule_fixed.value:
"tier_amount_rule"."calc_method" <> 'FIXED' OR (
        "tier_amount_rule"."formula_expression" IS NULL
        AND ("tier_amount_rule"."fixed_value" IS NOT NULL OR "tier_amount_rule"."percentage" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("tier_amount_rule"."percentage" IS NULL) = ("tier_amount_rule"."base_amount_type" IS NULL)
        AND ("tier_amount_rule"."base_amount_type" IS NULL OR "tier_amount_rule"."base_amount_type" <> "tier_amount_rule"."amount_type")
      )

chk_rule_formula.name: chk_rule_formula
chk_rule_formula.value:
"tier_amount_rule"."calc_method" <> 'FORMULA' OR (
        "tier_amount_rule"."formula_expression" IS NOT NULL
        AND "tier_amount_rule"."formula_expression" ~ '^[A-Z0-9_ .+\-*/()]+$'
        AND "tier_amount_rule"."base_amount_type" IS NULL AND "tier_amount_rule"."fixed_value" IS NULL AND "tier_amount_rule"."percentage" IS NULL
      )

chk_rule_minmax.name: chk_rule_minmax
chk_rule_minmax.value: "tier_amount_rule"."min_value" IS NULL OR "tier_amount_rule"."max_value" IS NULL OR "tier_amount_rule"."max_value" >= "tier_amount_rule"."min_value"

chk_tier_range.name: chk_tier_range
chk_tier_range.value: ("tier_config"."min_amount" IS NULL OR "tier_config"."min_amount" >= 0) AND ("tier_config"."min_amount" IS NULL OR "tier_config"."max_amount" IS NULL OR "tier_config"."max_amount" > "tier_config"."min_amount")
